mid_flight_journeys.description: One PatternAgent decomposition powers two sequential fan-out phases. Stage 1: each workflow runs planning agents in parallel (WorkflowStrategyAgent → ProjectOverviewAgent); planning artifacts are reviewed through the artifact/composer lane before implementation. Stage 2: after user approval via ContextVariablesAgent, each workflow runs implementation agents (ToolsManagerAgent → OrchestratorAgent); fan-in assembles the download bundle at PackMetadataAgent.
